description: Generate a personalized ROI business case for paying for Metrx. Uses real usage data to quantify optimization potential, then recommends Verify (a buyable per-verdict proof — no verdict, no charge) and Platform (priced to your managed LLM spend; talk to us). Ideal for agents that received a 402 and want a compelling proposal for their operator. Legacy Lite/Pro tiers are retired and never recommended. Returns structured data plus a report. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.
